text:
HackerTV and HackerTube inspired me to explore another corner of HN recommendations: places worth visiting and typefaces people enjoy using.

I built: https://hacker.living - a map and font collections with links back to the original comment.

I built this entirely using Codex, including the entire data pipeline and workers: extraction, transformation, and recommendations capture.

It's still an early stage preview, so some details need verification. Thanks for the inspiration!

Code: https://github.com/grandimam/hacker.living
title: Show HN: Hacker Living – HN's most recommended places
